SRC-BOILER-002.authority: Directorate of Steam Boilers, Maharashtra State
SRC-BOILER-002.note: Volumetric capacity 25 litres or more, steam pressure not less than 1 kg/cm2 or water temperature 100C or more. Water heated below 100C is a hot water generator and needs no registration.

SRC-BOILER-003.note: Excludes a pressure vessel (i) with capacity less than 25 litres, (ii) with less than 1 kg/cm2 design and working gauge pressure, or (iii) in which water is heated below 100 degrees centigrade. Exclusion is disjunctive, so inclusion requires all three.

SRC-ESIC-001.document_title: Employees State Insurance Act, 1948 s.1(5) and Maharashtra extension notifications
SRC-ESIC-001.note: SOURCES CONTRADICT. Some place Maharashtra at 20 employees; another cites a state notification reducing it to 10 w.e.f. 01-10-2020 for implemented areas; another states manufacturing units with power were already at 10. Maharashtra is a partially implemented state so coverage is district dependent, and a separate wage condition applies. Domain lead must obtain the notification itself.
